accepted.s: The Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 replaced which of the following earlier rules?
accepted.x: The Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 replaced the Batteries (Management and Handling) Rules, 2001. They were notified by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
accepted.tq: Direct recall of the replaced rules and the notifying authority.
accepted.sec: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 - EPR, recycling targets

accepted.s:
The Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022 apply to which of the following categories of batteries?
1. Electric vehicle batteries
2. Portable batteries
3. Automotive batteries
4. Industrial batteries
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Rules cover electric vehicle, portable, automotive and industrial batteries. Their scope is not restricted to any one battery category.
accepted.tq: Use the inclusive option when all listed categories belong to the regulatory scope.
accepted.sec: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 - EPR, recycling targets

accepted.s:
With reference to Extended Producer Responsibility under the Battery Waste Management Rules, 2022, consider the following statements:
1. Producers, including importers, must collect waste batteries.
2. Producers must recycle or refurbish waste batteries.
3. Producers must use recycled material in the manufacture of new batteries.
4. Producers may dispose of all waste batteries in landfills after collection.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Extended Producer Responsibility requires collection, recycling or refurbishment, and use of recycled material in new batteries. Landfill disposal is prohibited, making statement 4 false.
accepted.tq: Find the statement that reverses a regulatory obligation into a permitted practice.
accepted.sec: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 - EPR, recycling targets

accepted.s: The material recovery target under the Battery Waste Management Rules is scheduled to rise to what level by 2026–27?
accepted.x: The material recovery target is scheduled to rise to 90 percent by 2026–27.
accepted.tq: Directly distinguish the prescribed percentage from nearby plausible figures.
accepted.sec: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 - EPR, recycling targets

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Battery Pack Aadhaar (BPAN)?
o: A tax number assigned to battery recycling companies only
A subsidy card issued to owners of portable batteries
A unique identification system for lifecycle traceability of specified battery packs
A certification mark for imported solar panels
accepted.x: BPAN is a unique identification system intended to provide lifecycle traceability for electric vehicle batteries and industrial batteries above 2 kWh.
accepted.tq: Discriminate the exact function of a newly introduced identification mechanism.
accepted.sec: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 - EPR, recycling targets

accepted.s:
For which of the following is Battery Pack Aadhaar stated to be mandatory?
1. Electric vehicle batteries
2. Industrial batteries exceeding 2 kWh
3. All household electrical appliances
4. Portable batteries of every capacity
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: BPAN is mandatory for electric vehicle batteries and industrial batteries exceeding 2 kWh. The stated requirement does not cover all appliances or every portable battery.
accepted.tq: Separate the specified coverage threshold from overbroad alternatives.
accepted.sec: Battery Waste Management Rules 2022 - EPR, recycling targets

accepted.x: The Hazardous & Other Wastes (Amendment) Rules, 2025 extend EPR to specified non-ferrous scrap from April 2026.

accepted.s:
Consider the following sequence in a pumped storage hydropower plant:
1. Water is released through turbines during peak demand.
2. Surplus or off-peak electricity is used to pump water to an upper reservoir.
3. The stored water is retained for subsequent generation.
Which of the following is the correct sequence?
accepted.x: Surplus electricity first pumps water upward, the water is stored in the upper reservoir, and it is later released through turbines during peak demand.
accepted.tq: Arrange the operational stages from charging to discharging.

accepted.s: Pumped storage hydropower is often described as a ‘giant water battery’ because it primarily performs which function?
o: Uses water only for cooling thermal power plants
Stores electricity by moving water between reservoirs and generates power when required
Stores electricity permanently without any conversion losses
accepted.x: Pumped storage stores surplus electricity by pumping water to an upper reservoir and generates electricity when the water flows back through turbines. It is a long-duration storage system, not a permanent loss-free store.
accepted.tq: Apply the charging-and-discharging analogy to an operational situation.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II regarding pumped storage projects:

List-I (Project)
A. Pinnapuram
B. Tehri PSP
C. Koyna

List-II (Location)
1. Maharashtra
2. Uttarakhand
3. Andhra Pradesh

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: Pinnapuram is in Andhra Pradesh, Tehri PSP is in Uttarakhand and Koyna is in Maharashtra.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure location pair and eliminate codes that disturb it.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding identified pumped storage potential and planning is correct?
o: India has 258 GW of identified potential, of which 7 GW is operational and more than 17 GW is expected by 2030.
India has 25.8 GW of identified potential, of which 17 GW is operational and 7 GW is planned by 2030.
India has 7 GW of identified potential and 258 GW planned to be commissioned by 2030.
India has 258 GW operational capacity and no additional capacity planned by 2030.
accepted.x: The identified pumped storage potential is 258 GW, with 7 GW operational and more than 17 GW additional capacity planned by 2030.
accepted.tq: Keep potential, operational capacity and planned addition as separate quantities.

accepted.s: The Tehri Pumped Storage Project has a commissioned capacity of:
accepted.x: The Tehri Pumped Storage Project in Uttarakhand is stated to have 500 MW commissioned.
accepted.tq: Match the project with its specific commissioned capacity.

accepted.s: The Pinnapuram project is described as having a capacity of 1,680 MW and as the world’s first integrated renewable-energy storage project. It is associated with which company?
accepted.x: Pinnapuram is a Greenko project in Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, with a stated capacity of 1,680 MW.
accepted.tq: Use the project–company association to distinguish similar storage developers.

accepted.s: The 20 GWh lithium-ion cell and pack plant announced by Waaree Energy Storage involves an investment of approximately:
accepted.x: Waaree Energy Storage’s stated 20 GWh lithium-ion cell and pack plant involves an investment of ₹10,000 crore.

accepted.s: Why is energy storage regarded as a major bottleneck in integrating renewable energy into the power system?
o: Renewable energy can never be connected to a grid without coal generation.
Storage helps balance variable renewable generation and supports round-the-clock renewable electricity.
Storage eliminates the need for electricity transmission networks entirely.
Renewable energy is available only during peak electricity demand.
accepted.x: Storage addresses the variability of renewable generation and helps provide 24×7 renewable electricity. It does not eliminate the need for grids or imply that renewable energy is never grid-compatible.
accepted.tq: Apply the system-level role of storage to the renewable-integration problem.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding current energy-storage developments:
1. A 10 GWh ACC-PLI re-bid has been associated with grid storage.
2. Khavda BESS is among the current storage developments identified.
3. Falling lithium carbonate prices are relevant to the storage sector.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The 10 GWh ACC-PLI re-bid, Khavda BESS and falling lithium carbonate prices are all identified as current storage-sector developments.
accepted.tq: Test whether all three current-affairs linkages belong to the same sectoral update.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is identified as a major criticism of India’s advanced battery-storage ecosystem?
o: Excessive availability of lithium processing capacity in India
Complete domestic self-sufficiency in cell manufacturing
Dependence on imported cells and concentration of upstream minerals in a few countries
Absence of any policy support for battery manufacturing
accepted.x: The sector faces import dependence for cell manufacturing and concentration of upstream minerals, with more than 70 percent of lithium processing in a few countries. PLI delays are another concern.
accepted.tq: Choose the option that combines the stated structural weaknesses without using an absolute distortion.

accepted.s: Sodium-ion batteries are being promoted in the storage debate primarily as which of the following?
o: A system that cannot be used for stationary storage
A technology requiring more lithium than lithium-ion batteries
A replacement for all pumped storage projects
accepted.x: Sodium-ion technology is presented as a safer, mineral-light alternative. It is not described as a universal replacement for pumped storage or as dependent on more lithium.
accepted.tq: Match the emerging technology with its stated policy and resource advantage.

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Pumped Storage Promotion Policy, 2022 identifies what potential at how many sites?
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh Pumped Storage Promotion Policy, 2022 identifies 33,240 MW of potential at 29 sites.
accepted.tq: Keep the capacity figure and the number of sites together while rejecting swapped figures.

accepted.s: According to the stated planning figures for Andhra Pradesh, which combination represents the planned battery storage and pumped storage capacities?
o: 3,931 MW battery storage and 7,370 MW pumped storage
7,370 MW battery storage and 3,931 MW pumped storage
10 GWh battery storage and 1,680 MW pumped storage
1,200 MW battery storage and 33,240 MW pumped storage
accepted.x: The stated CEA planning figures for Andhra Pradesh are 3,931 MW of battery storage and 7,370 MW of pumped storage.
accepted.tq: Avoid reversing the two capacity categories in a paired numerical comparison.

accepted.s: A new pumped storage project of 1,200 MW was approved in which Andhra Pradesh district in January 2026?
accepted.x: A new 1,200 MW pumped storage project was approved in Kurnool in January 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine the project capacity, district and date to identify the correct current-affairs item.
